# Test fixtures

**These files are hand-written, not recorded.** They follow the response shapes in the
[Valet](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/valet-api-how-to/) and
[WDS](https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/developers/wds/user-guide) documentation, but every value is
made up (round, obviously synthetic numbers) and must never be read as real data.

They will be replaced by responses recorded from the live APIs once the identifiers are
verified (`uv run cdm verify`), keeping the values small enough to read in a diff.
